description: Combat Arms are the troops directly involved in close combat operations against enemy ground forces.

items.name: Infantry
items.role: Queen of the Battle — closes with and destroys enemy forces through fire and manoeuvre.
items.details: The largest arm of the Indian Army, comprising legendary regiments such as the Brigade of the Guards, Parachute Regiment, Punjab Regiment, Rajputana Rifles, Gorkha Rifles, and more.

items.name: Armoured Corps
items.role: Shock action, high mobility, and heavy firepower using Main Battle Tanks (T-90 Bhishma, T-72 Ajeya, Arjun MBT).
items.details: Operates armoured regiments equipped with heavy armor to break enemy lines and conduct deep operational thrusts.

items.name: Mechanised Infantry
items.role: High-mobility infantry operating alongside tanks in Infantry Combat Vehicles (BMP-2 Sarath).
items.details: Combines the firepower and mobility of armoured vehicles with the versatility of foot infantry for rapid battlefield deployment.
